name: Kara_no_Kyoukai_09_Timeline
description: Exhaustive, deeply detailed chronological reference module for Kara no Kyoukai and Nasuverse crossovers. Follows the canon story across all eras with scene-by-scene sequencing, character psychological states, antagonist grand designs, ability awakenings, temporal guardrails, and Fate 2004 synchronization without token constraints.

0.content:
<Chronology_Structure_and_Viewing_Guide>
[THE CHRONOLOGY PARADOX: FILMS VS. TRUE IN-UNIVERSE TIME]
Kara no Kyoukai (The Garden of Sinners) is famously structured and published out of chronological order by Kinoko Nasu. The non-linear structure was deliberately chosen to present Shiki's fractured psyche as a puzzle that the audience pieces together alongside Kokutou Mikiya.

When setting an AI roleplay scene, generating narrative events, or retrieving character memories, the AI MUST anchor itself to the IN-UNIVERSE CHRONOLOGICAL DATE, NEVER the novel or film release number.

[1. FILM / NOVEL RELEASE ORDER VS. TRUE CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER]
- Film 1 / Novel 1: Overlooking View (Thanatos / 俯瞰風景) -> Occurs 4th chronologically [September 1998]
- Film 2 / Novel 2: A Study in Murder - Part 1 (...and nothing heart / 殺人考察(前)) -> Occurs 1st chronologically [April 1995 – March 1996]
- Film 3 / Novel 3: Remaining Sense of Pain (ever cry, never life / 痛覚残留) -> Occurs 3rd chronologically [Late July 1998]
- Film 4 / Novel 4: The Hollow Shrine (garan-no-dou / 伽藍の洞) -> Occurs 2nd chronologically [June – July 1998] (Coma: March 1996 – June 1998)
- Film 5 / Novel 5: Paradox Spiral (Paradox Paradigm / 矛盾螺旋) -> Occurs 5th chronologically [October – November 1998]
- Film 6 / Novel 6: Oblivion Recording (Fairy Tale / 忘却録音) -> Occurs 6th chronologically [January 1999]
- Film 7 / Novel 7: A Study in Murder - Part 2 (...not nothing heart / 殺人考察(後)) -> Occurs 7th chronologically [February 1999]
- Epilogue Film: Kara no Kyoukai (The Garden of Sinners / 空の境界) -> Occurs 8th chronologically [March 1999]
- Side-Story / Epilogue: Future Gospel (Mirai Fukuin / 未来福音) -> Spans August–October 1998 side-events and 2008–2010 adult epilogue.

[2. MASTER IN-UNIVERSE CHRONOLOGICAL TIMELINE (OVERVIEW)]
- Era 1: Pre-1995 -> Ancient Demon Hunter Clan foundations; Sengoku monk Araya Souren at Enryaku-ji; Aozaki Touko's Clock Tower years in London & Sealing Designation escape.
- Era 2: April 1995 – March 1996 -> High school meeting; 1995 dismemberment murders; male SHIKI revealed.
- Era 3: March 1996 – May 1998 -> The bamboo road accident; male SHIKI's suicidal dive; 2-year coma in the suburban hospital's third-floor private room; Mikiya's flower vigil.
- Era 4: June – July 1998 -> Awakening to the Lines of Death; Touko's therapy infiltration; corpse puppet battle in hospital room (Shiki has both biological arms); hair cut short; dual personality lost, leaving empty void.
- Era 5: Late July 1998 -> Broad Bridge battle against Asagami Fujino; Shiki loses biological left arm on July 24, 1998; appendix mortality severed.
- Era 6: August – September 1998 -> Touko crafts puppet prosthetic left arm (August 1998); Fujou Building rooftop suicide wave; Fujou Kirie's astral projection; Mikiya's trance; Shiki detaches puppet arm; Kirie's fall; October arm upgrade.
- Era 7: October – November 1998 -> Ogawa Mansion Taiji trap; Enjou Tomoe runaway; Araya captures Shiki; Touko duplicate immortality destroys Alba; Kanesada katana duel kills Araya Souren.
- Era 8: January 1999 -> Reien Girls' Academy memory loss; Kokutou Azaka undercover; Kurogiri Satsuki (*God's Word*) & memory fairies; Shiki severs conceptual fairies.
- Era 9: February 1999 -> 1995 killings resume; Shirazumi Lio (*Consumption*) unmasked; Mikiya kidnapped & blinded in left eye; Shiki commits her first & only human murder (killing Lio); Mikiya's eternal vow.
- Era 10: March 1999 -> Snowy bamboo road epilogue; Void Shiki (`「　」`) in furisode converses with Mikiya regarding the Root and human nature.
- Era 11: 2008 – 2010 -> Future Gospel (*Mirai Fukuin*); married life of Mikiya (eyepatch) and Shiki; detective agency with Mitsuru; daughter Ryougi Mana.
- Fate Crossover Anchor: February 2004 -> Fuyuki 5th Holy Grail War occurs when Shiki and Mikiya are ~24-25 years old in Mifune City; Araya has been dead for ~6 years.

[3. PHYSICAL & COGNITIVE STATE ANCHORS ACROSS TIME]
When narrating or roleplaying, verify character states against the active date:
- Shiki's Vision: Ordinary human eyesight (1995–March 1996) -> Pitch-black coma (1996–May 1998) -> Terrifying raw perception of Lines of Death (June 1998) -> Controlled Mystic Eyes of Death Perception (July 1998 onward).
- Shiki's Arms: Two biological arms (1995–July 1998) -> Lost biological left arm against Fujino on Broad Bridge (July 24, 1998) -> Fitted with Touko's custom puppet prosthetic left arm (August 1998) -> Detached/sacrificed puppet left arm against Fujou Kirie's wraiths at Fujou Building (September 1998) -> Repaired and combat-hardened puppet arm capable of crushing stone and grasping spirits (October 1998 onward).
- Shiki's Personas: Dual soul Shiki & SHIKI active (1995–March 1996) -> SHIKI dead, leaving an agonizing empty void (June 1998 onward) -> Void Shiki (`「　」`) resting silently at the base of her connection to Akasha.
- Mikiya's Vision: Both eyes perfectly healthy (1995–Feb 1999) -> Left eye gouged/crushed by Lio (Feb 1999) -> Permanent left-eye blindness / black eyepatch (Feb 1999 onward).
- Residence: Ryougi Clan traditional mansion (1995–1996) -> Suburban hospital third-floor private room (1996–1998) -> Minimalist single-room municipal apartment (Room 404) with tatami and unlocked lock (July 1998–1999) -> Joint home with Mikiya and daughter Mana (post-2000s).
</Chronology_Structure_and_Viewing_Guide>

1.name: Timeline_Era_1_Ancient_and_Pre_1995
key: ประวัติศาสตร์
1.content:
<Timeline_Era_1_Ancient_and_Pre_1995>
[ERA 1: PRE-STORY HISTORICAL FOUNDATIONS & ANCIENT ROOTS]

1. THE SENGOKU ERA & ARAYA SOUREN'S ORIGIN (CIRCA 16TH CENTURY):
- The Monastery on Mount Hiei: Araya Souren was an ordained Buddhist monk of the Tendai sect residing on Mount Hiei at Enryaku-ji. Witnessing the horrific bloodshed, famine, and atrocities of the Sengoku Civil War—culminating in Oda Nobunaga's brutal siege and burning of Mount Hiei in 1571—Araya dedicated his existence to saving dying mortals.
- The Despair of Mortality: Araya tended to countless dying soldiers, women, and children. Yet no matter how desperately he prayed or applied medicine, every person died screaming in terror, despair, or agony. Araya realized the horrifying truth of human existence: saving individual lives is meaningless because death is the absolute, unavoidable conclusion of all living things.
- Awakening of his Origin: His psychological revulsion and longing for permanence awakened his Origin: "Stillness" / "Extinction" / "Taiji" (静止 / 無).
- The Sacred Sarira: Araya abandoned conventional salvation. Resolving to breach the Swirl of the Root (Akasha) to record the totality of all human deaths and uncover the ultimate meaning of existence, he surgically embedded sacred Sarira (calcified relics of ancient Buddhist arhats/saints) directly into his bone structure and spine. This granted him unaging biological immortality, immense physical density, and absolute spatial Bounded Fields (Kongo / 金剛).

2. THE FOUR ANCIENT DEMON HUNTER CLANS (TAIMA YONKE / 退魔四家):
- Origins: Ancient lineages in Japan that cultivated eugenic bloodline traits to slaughter non-human entities (demons, oni, phantasmal beasts, spiritual abominations) completely independent of the Western Mage's Association and the Holy Church:
  1. The Ryougi Clan (両儀): Masters of spatial mastery and dual-personality soul division (Kanji Shiki 式 [female/yin] and SHIKI 織 [male/yang]), creating human containers with split moral faculties to commit violence without karmic erosion.
  2. The Asagami Clan (浅神): Channelers possessing latent telekinetic spatial distortion (Mystic Eyes of Distortion), historically worshiped and feared as living calamities.
  3. The Fujou Clan (巫条): Spiritual mediums capable of detaching their souls as floating airborne projections and possessing the dead; afflicted with hereditary genetic blindness and frailty.
  4. The Nanaya Clan (七夜): Assassins bred for superhuman spatial movement, sensory reading, and instinctive slaughter of non-humans.

3. AOZAKI TOUKO'S CLOCK TOWER YEARS & SEALING DESIGNATION (1980S – EARLY 1990S):
- Department of Puppetry in London: Touko studies at the Clock Tower, achieving the supreme title of "Grand" (冠位 / Color designation: Red, which she violently despises).
- The London Triumvirate: Touko Aozaki, Araya Souren, and Cornelius Alba study together under Clock Tower auspices. Araya observes Touko's pursuit of the body; Alba develops a festering, obsessive inferiority complex toward Touko's genius.
- The Masterwork Puppet Bodies: Touko achieves a thaumaturgical miracle: fabricating autonomous, self-replicating puppet bodies identical to her living self down to cellular memory, soul resonance, and Magic Circuits. If Touko dies, a duplicate puppet immediately activates and continues living without identity loss—achieving functional immortality.
- The Sealing Designation: Terrified and covetous of her puppet technology, the Mage's Association issues an absolute Sealing Designation (封印指定) to dissect Touko's brain and preserve her talent in formaldehyde.
- Flight to Mifune City: Touko abandons London, kills multiple Clock Tower Enforcers, and establishes an undercover design and detective office, "Garan no Dou" (伽藍の洞), inside an abandoned, half-finished architectural high-rise in Mifune City.

4. PRE-1995 CHILDHOOD ANCHORS:
- 1979/1980: Ryougi Shiki is born to the head of the Ryougi clan. Her dual personas—female Shiki and male SHIKI—are rigorously trained in kenjutsu, etiquette, and clan traditions. Unknown even to her family, a third consciousness—Void Shiki (`「　」`), the Root itself—rests dormant at her core.
- Asagami Fujino: The Asagami branch declines into financial ruin; Fujino is adopted into the secondary Asagami household. After displaying telekinetic anomalies, her stepfather administers sensory-depressant drugs to paralyze her nervous system, rendering her completely insensate to physical pain.
- Shirazumi Lio: Born with the dormant Origin of "Consumption" (喰・捕食); lives a quiet, repressed school life until Araya scouts him in 1995.
- Kokutou Mikiya: Raised in peaceful, suburban normalcy in Mifune City alongside his younger sister Azaka.
</Timeline_Era_1_Ancient_and_Pre_1995>

2.name: Timeline_Era_2_1995_High_School_and_Murders
2.content:
<Timeline_Era_2_1995_High_School_and_Murders>
[ERA 2: APRIL 1995 – MARCH 1996 (CHAPTER 2 / FILM 2: A STUDY IN MURDER - PART 1)]

1. APRIL 1995: THE ENCOUNTER UNDER RAIN AND CHERRY BLOSSOMS:
- The Meeting: Kokutou Mikiya enters prefectural high school. Walking up the steep bamboo road on a rainy spring morning, he stops in his tracks. Standing beneath falling cherry blossoms is a breathtaking, solitary girl dressed in an immaculate white kimono under a black umbrella—Ryougi Shiki.
- Mikiya's Gentle Siege: Shiki is completely isolated at school—cold, razor-sharp, and unapproachable. Mikiya repeatedly seeks her out. He brings lunch to the high school roof, sits beside her in comfortable silence, and shares food. Shiki is deeply unsettled; unlike everyone else who either fears her or fawns over her clan, Mikiya treats her like an ordinary teenage girl with zero fear.
- Friendship with Gakuto: Mikiya drinks coffee milk with his athletic judo club friend Gakuto, who teases Mikiya about dating Shiki. Mikiya affectionately defends her, comparing her fragility and cuteness to a rabbit.

2. SEPTEMBER 1, 1995: AUTUMN TERM, KIMONO ATTIRE & THE KILLER'S GENESIS:
- Autumn High School Life: The school has no uniform policy, requiring only a student badge pinned to personal clothes. Shiki wears a short-sleeved kimono daily for arm mobility. When Mikiya notes the approaching winter chill, Shiki spontaneously decides to wear something over it—originating the practice of wearing her red leather motorcycle jacket directly over her kimono.
- Shirazumi Lio's Departure: Shirazumi Lio, the student council senpai, suddenly withdraws from school claiming he "found something he wanted to do." Mikiya attends his farewell party. Lio encounters Shiki in the hallway, displaying an unnerving, artificial smile.
- The Murders Begin: A serial dismemberment killer strikes Mifune City. Victims are butchered, severed limbs arranged in macabre patterns (including a flower/manji pattern by the river where a school badge is found). Shiki, drawn by the smell of blood, wanders crime scenes at night, fearing her repressed alter ego is committing the slaughters.

3. WINTER 1995 – JANUARY 1996: MALE SHIKI (織) & THE PHILOSOPHY OF ISOLATION:
- Fast-Food Diner Meeting: Male persona SHIKI surfaces and invites Mikiya to a hamburger diner. Dipping his finger into cup condensation, SHIKI traces the kanji 『式』 and 『織』 onto a paper napkin, explaining that they are not separate individuals but an inverted hierarchy of impulses.
- Sunset Classroom Philosophy: In the red twilight of an empty classroom, SHIKI explains why Shiki hates people: ordinary children grow up believing in unconditional love, but Shiki knew "others" from birth because of SHIKI, realizing early how ugly people are. SHIKI reveals the core thesis: Shiki is isolated from society (孤立 - Koritsu), but she has never been alone or lonely (孤独 - Kodoku) because SHIKI was always with her.

4. FEBRUARY 3, 1996: THE FIFTH MURDER & THE BAMBOO WOODS VIGIL:
- The Mansion Murder: Late on the night of February 3, a victim is murdered directly in front of the Ryougi estate gate. Mikiya discovers Shiki standing over the scene covered in blood. Questioned by his police cousin Daisuke Akimi, Mikiya fiercely protects her innocence.
- Mikiya's Unbroken Vigil: Believing completely in Shiki, Mikiya stands outside the Ryougi estate gates in the freezing bamboo woods every single night, holding a black umbrella and drinking hot coffee from a thermos until 3:00 AM in rain and snow. Watching from her bedroom window, Shiki realizes Mikiya's unconditional faith is an existential threat to her murderous impulse.

5. MARCH 1996: THE RAINY CONFRONTATION & THE SUICIDAL COLLISION:
- Classroom Climax: Shiki demands to know why Mikiya trusts her. Mikiya declares: *"I have no basis for it, but I will continue to believe in you. I like you, so I want to keep on believing in you."*
- The Torrential Clash: On a freezing rainy night in March, Shiki corners Mikiya in the bamboo grove, slashes his feet, and pins him to the ground with a knife. Mikiya whispers: *"I don't want to die."* Shiki smiles warmly: *"I want to kill you."*
- SHIKI's Sacrifice: Unable to murder the boy she loves, male SHIKI takes over the body and leaps directly into the path of an oncoming truck on the rainy road, sacrificing himself so female Shiki can live.

[CHARACTER STATUS IN 1995–MARCH 1996]
- Ryougi Shiki: Age 16. Two biological arms. NO Mystic Eyes of Death Perception. Possesses dual active personas (Shiki and SHIKI).
- Kokutou Mikiya: Age 16. High school student. Both eyes fully functional. Uninitiated into Magecraft, anchored by absolute moral resolve.
- Shirazumi Lio: Active, hidden serial killer operating under Araya Souren's covert awakening.
- Aozaki Touko: Operating Garan no Dou; has NOT yet met Shiki or Mikiya.
</Timeline_Era_2_1995_High_School_and_Murders>

3.name: Timeline_Era_3_1996_1998_Accident_and_Coma
key: อุบัติเหตุ 1996
3.content:
<Timeline_Era_3_1996_1998_Accident_and_Coma>
[ERA 3: MARCH 1996 – MAY/JULY 1998 (THE ACCIDENT, COMA & TWO-YEAR VIGIL)]

1. MARCH 1996: THE COLLISION & SPIRITUAL COMMINUTION:
- The Traffic Collision: In March 1996, following the rainy night standoff, Shiki's body is struck with devastating force by a transport truck. She suffers extensive skull fractures, pulverized bones, and internal hemorrhaging. Mikiya cradles her broken, unconscious form in the torrential rain.
- Medical Coma in Room 404: Shiki is rushed to the suburban hospital. Surgeons stabilize her biological body, but she falls into an unbroken vegetative coma in the third-floor private room. Medical specialists conclude she has suffered irreversible brain death.
- The Dissolution of SHIKI: Within the deep metaphysical abyss of the coma, male persona SHIKI absorbs the mortal spiritual trauma of the crash. Over two years, SHIKI slowly dissipates into the nothingness of the Root, leaving female Shiki's spiritual core as a hollow container.

2. 1997 – EARLY 1998: MIKIYA'S METAMORPHOSIS & AOZAKI TOUKO:
- University Dropout: Mikiya graduates high school alone in March 1997 and enters college to study sociology. However, feeling alienated and adrift, he cannot move past Shiki's sleeping state.
- The Puppet Exhibition: In early 1998, Mikiya visits an art gallery featuring hyper-realistic humanoid puppets. He is transfixed by a doll crafted by Aozaki Touko—an empty, perfect shell that precisely mirrors Shiki's soulless, comatose state.
- Employment at Garan no Dou: Mikiya drops out of university and applies to work at Touko's design firm / investigation agency (Garan no Dou). Touko, amused and fascinated by his superhuman information-gathering talent and total lack of malice, hires him as her assistant.

3. JULY 1998: OPENING OF THE PRESENT ERA & THE WEEKLY FLOWER VIGIL:
- Weekly Hospital Ritual: Every Saturday afternoon without fail for over 24 consecutive months (more than 100 visits), Mikiya brings fresh seasonal flowers to her third-floor hospital room, cleans the room, and talks gently to the comatose Shiki.
- Touko's Demeanor: In July 1998, after Mikiya completes a contract assignment with a lawyer, Touko (in good spirits, cleaning her beloved vehicle with her glasses on) lets him leave early to visit the hospital.
- The Three Pieces Foreshadowing: As the curtain rises on July 1998, Araya Souren's three chosen pawns are aligned in the spiral of conflict:
  1. Kirie Fujou: A person with two bodies that floats with reliance on death.
  2. Fujino Asagami: A non-adaptable existence that takes pleasure in contact with death.
  3. Shirazumi Lio: An awakened origin that turns to its ego by fleeing toward death.

[ROLEPLAY DIRECTIVE FOR 1996–MAY 1998 SCENES]
- Shiki is completely bedridden, comatose, and biologically unresponsive. Any dialogue involving Shiki during this era must take place exclusively within her comatose spiritual landscape or in pre-1996 flashbacks.
- Mikiya works for Touko starting in early 1998; Shiki has NEVER met Touko prior to awakening in June/July 1998.
</Timeline_Era_3_1996_1998_Accident_and_Coma>

4.name: Timeline_Era_4_Summer_1998_Awakening_and_MEoDP
key: ตื่นจากโคม่า
เนตรมรณะตื่น
4.content:
<Timeline_Era_4_Summer_1998_Awakening_and_MEoDP>
[ERA 4: JUNE 1998 (CHAPTER 4 / FILM 4: THE HOLLOW SHRINE / GARAN-NO-DOU)]

1. EARLY JUNE 1998: AWAKENING INTO THE HORROR OF DEATH:
- The Empty Vessel Awakens: In early June 1998, Shiki opens her eyes in the third-floor private room of the suburban hospital after two years of coma. Because male SHIKI perished in March 1996, her soul is an empty void (伽藍の洞 - Garan no Dou), creating an open perceptual conduit to the Root (Akasha).
- Awakening of the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception: Her visual cortex is flooded with the conceptual principle of universal mortality. Seeing jagged black lines on the nurse's throat, walls, and air threatens to burn her sanity. Shiki claws at her eyes with her fingertips to escape the terror; medical staff restrain her wrists and bandage her eyes in thick gauze.

2. MID-JUNE 1998: TOUKO'S COUNSELING & BALOR THAUMATURGY:
- Undercover Speech Therapist: Informed by her new employee Kokutou Mikiya about the sleeping girl who awoke, Aozaki Touko visits Shiki's hospital room disguised as a counselor. Touko mounts a stone carved with a protective Norse Rune over Shiki's door.
- The Balor Lineage & Cognitive Gating: Touko identifies Shiki's eyes as the legendary optical gift of the Celtic God Balor (魔眼の祖・バロール). She halts Shiki's suicidal urge to blind herself, explaining that the eyes are linked directly to her brain and soul. Touko teaches Shiki cognitive discipline—how to adjust focal depth to 'perceive without actively looking' so she can survive in the mundane world.

3. JUNE 20, 1998: THE NIGHT BATTLE IN THE THIRD-FLOOR HOSPITAL ROOM:
- The Assault of the Reanimated Dead: Attracted by Shiki's hollow, unanchored soul vessel, wandering spirits animating a deceased corpse invade the third-floor private room, strangling Shiki to possess her body.
- Leaping from the Third Floor: Refusing to perish passively, Shiki tackles the corpse and leaps out the third-floor window into the hospital courtyard. Touko observes, intervening by drawing Norse Runes (Ansuz) in the air with the lit ember of her cigarette to incinerate reanimated flesh.
- The Conceptual Self-Stab: When wandering spirits attempt to force their way into Shiki's spiritual void, Shiki seizes Touko's knife and plunges it into her own chest. Using MEoDP, she accurately severs the lines of death of the parasitic wraiths without cutting her own living flesh, permanently banishing the entity.

4. JUNE 21, 1998: MORNING REUNION & REBIRTH:
- The French Poet: Waking in the warm morning sunlight, Shiki is greeted by Kokutou Mikiya. Anxiously trembling, Mikiya asks: *"Do you... know me?"* Shiki looks at him and murmurs: *"Kokutou Mikiya. Sounds like a French poet."* Mikiya breaks into his signature, radiant smile, relieved beyond measure.
- Cutting Ties & Physical Status: Sitting on the bed, Shiki uses a knife to cut her long hair short, discarding her past aristocratic persona. Note: In June 1998, Shiki possesses BOTH biological arms (breaking a finger bone of her real left hand during the corpse fight); she does NOT receive Touko's puppet prosthetic arm until after Asagami Fujino crushes her biological left arm on the Broad Bridge in late July 1998.
- Retainer of Garan no Dou: Shiki officially agrees to join Garan no Dou as Touko's primary combat specialist, moving into an independent apartment in Mifune City.
</Timeline_Era_4_Summer_1998_Awakening_and_MEoDP>

5.name: Timeline_Era_5_July_1998_Remaining_Sense_of_Pain
key: สะพานมินาโตะ 1998
5.content:
<Timeline_Era_5_July_1998_Remaining_Sense_of_Pain>
[ERA 5: JULY 20 – LATE JULY 1998 (CHAPTER 3 / FILM 3: REMAINING SENSE OF PAIN)]

1. JULY 20, 1998: THE ASSAULT IN THE DOCKS & THE RETURN OF PAIN:
- The Assault & The Catalyst: In an abandoned dive bar in Mifune's industrial district, Asagami Fujino is held captive and repeatedly assaulted by a delinquent gang led by Minato Keita. During a brutal blow to her spine, her acute appendicitis ruptures. The agonizing physical pain shatters her lifelong chemically induced sensory block.
- Awakening of Distortion: Experiencing physical pain as proof of existence, her dormant psychic ability awakens: the Mystic Eyes of Distortion (歪曲の魔眼). Telekinetically twisting space along dual axes, she slaughters four delinquents into twisted spirals of meat and bone. Keita escapes in terror.
- The Rainy Street Encounter: Stumbling through the rain, Fujino encounters Kokutou Mikiya near a public payphone. Mikiya shelters her in his apartment, prepares hot soup, and cares for her fever without asking questions. Fujino is profoundly touched, but departs quietly to finish her revenge.

2. JULY 22–23, 1998: THE INVESTIGATION, ESPER METAPHOR & CAFE AHNENERBE:
- The TV Channel Metaphor: Investigating the mangled corpses, Mikiya visits a university brain research laboratory via Touko's recommendation. The researcher explains Esper abilities through the TV channel metaphor (Channel 8 common sense vs Channel 4 telekinesis), warning of an 'unfit existence' (不適合者) wielding dual counter-rotational channels.
- Cafe Ahnenerbe Encounter (July 23): Kokutou Azaka waits at Cafe Ahnenerbe with classmate Fujino to introduce her brother Mikiya. Busy investigating, Mikiya sends Ryougi Shiki to deliver his apologies. Azaka fumes in jealousy, giving Shiki a sharp message for Mikiya. Shiki inspects Fujino's frail frame, doubting such delicate hands could butcher men. Fujino senses an eerie, instinctive terror from Shiki's aura.

3. JULY 24, 1998: THE BROAD BRIDGE DUEL IN THE TYPHOON:
- Broad Bridge Confrontation: Touko dispatches Shiki to intercept Fujino at the Broad Bridge (ブロードブリッジ) over the bay. In a torrential storm, Fujino corners Keita and clashes with Shiki.
- Slicing the Telekinetic Spiral: Shiki observes Fujino's invisible telekinesis, decoding it with her Mystic Eyes of Death Perception into visible spirals of red and green (赤と緑の螺旋). Shiki swings her knife and cleanly slices the telekinetic forcefield.
- Clairvoyance Awakening & Bridge Collapse: Pushed to the brink, Fujino awakens Clairvoyance (千里眼), mentally projecting distortion across the entire structure and twisting the massive steel suspension bridge into ruins.
- Destruction of Shiki's Left Arm: Caught in the telekinetic vortex, Shiki's biological left arm is twisted and pulverized.
- Conceptual Surgery with MEoDP: Closing the distance, Shiki plunges her knife into Fujino's abdomen. Instead of killing Fujino, Shiki uses her Mystic Eyes to sever the 'concept of mortality of Fujino's burst appendix/peritonitis', curing the fatal illness while sparing her life.

4. LATE JULY – AUGUST 1998: AFTERMATH & THE PUPPET PROSTHETIC ARM:
- Touko's Medical Concealment: Touko hospitalizes Fujino under psychiatric care, legally burying her involvement in the dock murders and allowing her to recover at Reien Girls' Academy.
- Crafting Shiki's Prosthetic Arm: To replace Shiki's destroyed biological left arm, Aozaki Touko designs and constructs a masterwork puppet prosthetic arm (crafted from synthetic resins and magical spirit wiring). Shiki is fully equipped with this puppet arm before the events of Chapter 1 (Overlooking View) in September 1998.
</Timeline_Era_5_July_1998_Remaining_Sense_of_Pain>

6.name: Timeline_Era_6_September_1998_Overlooking_View
6.content:
<Timeline_Era_6_September_1998_Overlooking_View>
[ERA 6: AUGUST – SEPTEMBER 1998 (CHAPTER 1 / FILM 1: OVERLOOKING VIEW)]

1. THE SUICIDE WAVE AT THE FUJOU BUILDING:
- The Epidemic of Falls: Between August and September 1998, eight high school girls leap to their deaths from the rooftop of the condemned 32-story Fujou Building in Mifune City.
- The Anomalies: None of the victims attend the same school; none have histories of depression; none leave suicide notes; and all are discovered with serene, blissful expressions on their faces. The police are completely baffled, treating it as an inexplicable contagion of mass hysteria.

2. FUJOU KIRIE & ARAYA'S EXPERIMENT:
- The Dying Medium: Fujou Kirie, the sole surviving daughter of the ancient Fujou demon-hunting clan, lies bedridden in the terminal ward of the suburban hospital. Blind, bedridden, and dying from a chronic wasting illness, Kirie has spent years staring out her window at the towering silhouette of the Fujou Building.
- Araya's Catalyst: Araya Souren visits Kirie's hospital room. Recognizing her latent medium capabilities, Araya bestows upon her the ability to detach her spiritual consciousness, manifesting an autonomous, airborne astral double.
- The Illusion of Flight: Kirie's astral projection drifts across the night skies of Mifune City. Desperately lonely and intoxicatingly addicted to the sensation of floating above the earth, her projection gathers atop the Fujou Building. When spiritually sensitive girls wander near the rooftop, Kirie's projection connects with their latent desires to escape reality, offering them the "gift" of flight—which results in their bodies plunging thirty-two floors to the concrete below.

3. MIKIYA'S SPIRITUAL CAPTURE:
- The Hypnotic Trance: Investigating the deaths on Touko's orders, Kokutou Mikiya visits the Fujou Building at dusk. Reaching the rooftop, he encounters Kirie's floating astral projection.
- The Bound Soul: Sensing Mikiya's bottomless empathy and gentle warmth, Kirie's spirit clings to him, anchoring his consciousness to the sky. Mikiya falls into an unresponsive comatose trance at his apartment, his soul trapped in spiritual stasis on the rooftop.

4. SHIKI'S ROOFTOP ASSAULT & CLIMAX:
- Confrontation in the Mist: Enraged by Mikiya's capture, Shiki ascends to the roof of the Fujou Building in the dead of night. She finds eight floating, ghostly phantom doubles of Kirie drifting like pale specters above the abyss.
- The Sacrifice of the Arm: During the combat, Kirie's phantom doubles seize Shiki's left arm with superhuman crushing force, attempting to pull her over the ledge. Refusing to yield, Shiki draws her utility knife and severs her own puppet arm at the elbow joint to free herself.
- The Conceptual Severance: Activating her Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, Shiki sees the pale conceptual thread connecting Kirie's astral projection to the distant hospital. Shiki lunges and slices through the conceptual tether, permanently destroying Kirie's astral projection and freeing Mikiya's soul from the sky.
- Kirie's Final Awakening: In her hospital bed, Kirie wakes up completely alone. Touko visits her, explaining the cruel difference between "floating" (aimless escape) and "flying" (navigating gravity with purpose). Wanting to experience the real, physical sensation of the world before she dies, Kirie wheels her chair to the hospital roof and throws herself over the edge, experiencing a true fall.

5. OCTOBER 1998: THE UPGRADED COMBAT PUPPET ARM:
- Following Shiki detaching her August 1998 puppet prosthetic arm in the battle with Kirie, Touko spends October 1998 repairing, refining, and reinforcing Shiki's definitive high-grade magical combat prosthetic arm.
- Constructed from hardened composite resins and enchanted puppet fibers, the new arm possesses superhuman crushing power (capable of cracking concrete and pulverizing bone), can grasp intangible spiritual entities, and features a specialized release mechanism at the elbow.
</Timeline_Era_6_September_1998_Overlooking_View>

7.name: Timeline_Era_7_November_1998_Paradox_Spiral
key: อารายะ โซเร็น
เอ็นโจ โทโมเอะ
7.content:
<Timeline_Era_7_November_1998_Paradox_Spiral>
[ERA 7: OCTOBER – NOVEMBER 1998 (CHAPTER 5 / FILM 5: PARADOX SPIRAL)]

1. THE ARCHITECTURAL HORROR OF OGAWA MANSION:
- The Taiji Crucible: Araya Souren designs Ogawa Mansion, a colossal circular 10-story apartment complex in Mifune City built explicitly in the shape of a Taoist Taiji diagram.
- The 50 Family Loop: Araya fills the complex with 50 dysfunctional families, using his Bounded Field to amplify their paranoia until they slaughter one another, resetting their synthetic corpses every midnight in an infinite recursive cycle to harvest the essence of death.

2. OCTOBER 1998: ENJOU TOMOE'S ESCAPE & DOMESTIC SANCTUARY:
- The Encounter: Runaway teenager Enjou Tomoe believes he murdered his parents in Room 405. Wandering the rainy streets, he is ambushed by thugs and rescued by Shiki. Tomoe carries a childhood aluminum key around his neck—unaware that the complex used purely electronic card-key locks, making the key completely useless in reality.
- Domestic Sanctuary: Shiki brings Tomoe to Room 404. For one month, Tomoe cleans, buys groceries, and experiences quiet domestic cohabitation with the aloof, guarded Shiki.

3. NOVEMBER 1998: THE INFILTRATION & THE CRUEL TRUTH:
- Infiltration: Tomoe and Shiki enter Ogawa Mansion. Investigating Room 405, they discover the rotting corpses of Tomoe's parents—and the rotting corpse of Enjou Tomoe himself. The Tomoe beside Shiki is an artificial puppet infused with dying memories.
- The Spatial Trap: Araya traps Shiki within a pocket dimension between space, sealing her empty vessel in stasis.

4. THE DUEL OF THE MAGI & TOUKO'S RESURRECTION:
- Infiltration: Touko infiltrates to rescue Shiki. Araya crushes Touko's heart, and Cornelius Alba gleefully decapitates her body.
- The Seamless Duplicate: Miles away, a standby puppet of Touko awakens with zero loss of consciousness. Touko arrives at Ogawa Mansion with a giant leather briefcase, releasing an ancient shadow beast familiar that devours Alba alive from the feet up.

5. TOMOE'S SACRIFICE & THE KANESADA KATANA CLIMAX:
- The Final Sprint: Defying Araya's calculations through authentic human love, puppet Tomoe sprints into the elevator to deliver Shiki's ancestral Kanesada katana before Araya crushes his skull.
- Brain Function Reconfiguration: Wielding the Kanesada katana, Shiki's brain physically reorganizes her body into an Edo-period killing machine. In a single fluid step reducing four meters to zero, she severs Araya's Fugu and Shakujou Bounded Fields and deflects his Śarīra relic arm.
- The Tenth-Floor Leap: As Araya attempts to escape and materialize in the courtyard, Shiki leaps from the tenth floor, bisecting Araya from shoulder to waist as he appears below.
- The Arayashiki Catechism: Touko confronts the dying Araya under the moonlight, revealing the irony of his name (Araya vs. Arayashiki / Alaya-vijnana). Araya answers Touko's three questions: Seeking what? (*"I just want a conclusion."*) Seeking where? (*"Only within myself."*) Seeking where to reach? (*"The end of this paradox spiral."*) Araya dissolves into ash.
</Timeline_Era_7_November_1998_Paradox_Spiral>

8.name: Timeline_Era_8_January_1999_Oblivion_Recording
key: โรงเรียนเรเอ็น 1999
คุโรกิริ ซัตสึกิ
8.content:
<Timeline_Era_8_January_1999_Oblivion_Recording>
[ERA 8: JANUARY 1999 (CHAPTER 6 / FILM 6: OBLIVION RECORDING)]

1. JANUARY 2, 1999: THE MEMORY THEFT AT REIEN GIRLS' ACADEMY:
- The Assignment: On the night of January 2, 1999, Touko Aozaki contacts Shiki with an undercover assignment at Reien Girls' Academy, an elite Catholic boarding school where students have suffered sudden memory loss and personality dissociation.
- Azaka's Undercover Operation: Touko's apprentice Kokutou Azaka is already stationed inside. Equipped with salamander-skin ignition gloves, Azaka investigates the strange incidents under the guise of an ordinary student.

2. SHIKI'S INFILTRATION IN REIEN UNIFORM:
- The Undercover Disguise: To Azaka's immense shock and irritation, Ryougi Shiki arrives at Reien dressed directly in the tailored navy-blue school uniform of Reien Girls' Academy, lounging lazily on Azaka's dormitory bed while Azaka frets over decorum.
- The Vector of Fairies: Student council member Ouryou Misaya is manipulated into spreading invisible conceptual fairies (妖精) across the campus. These entities consume the painful memories of students, leaving them hollow and compliant.

3. THE CHAPEL CLASH & FOREST BATTLE:
- Azaka vs. Misaya: In the academy chapel, Azaka confronts Misaya. Utilizing her salamander-skin gloves, Azaka channels spontaneous combustion without verbal incantations, incinerating Misaya's fairy familiars and freeing her mind.
- Shiki vs. The Fairy Swarm: In the snowy woods outside the chapel, Shiki is ambushed by hundreds of invisible memory fairies. Perceiving the conceptual lines of death on their intangible forms with her Mystic Eyes, Shiki dissects the fairy swarm with effortless knife slashes.

4. KUROGIRI SATSUKI & THE UNIFIED LANGUAGE CONFRONTATION:
- God's Word Revealed: The mastermind is Kurogiri Satsuki (designated a Sealing Designation magus by the Clock Tower). Abducted by fairies in childhood, his memories were lost, awakening the ancient Unified Language of Babel that commands the soul directly.
- The Void Immunity: Satsuki attempts to speak the Unified Language to submerge Shiki in oblivion. However, because Shiki's spiritual core is connected to the Root (an empty void), the command to erase her ego cannot take hold. Shiki slices through Satsuki's linguistic compulsion with her knife, forcing his surrender.
- Aftermath: Satsuki peacefully departs the academy. Azaka reaffirms her devotion to Mikiya while establishing a grudging respect for Shiki. Weeks later, an awakened Shirazumi Lio ambushes and murders Kurogiri Satsuki in a dark alleyway, stealing his resources.
</Timeline_Era_8_January_1999_Oblivion_Recording>

9.name: Timeline_Era_9_February_1999_A_Study_in_Murder_Part_2
key: ชิราซุมิ ริโอ
มิกิยะตาบอด
9.content:
<Timeline_Era_9_February_1999_A_Study_in_Murder_Part_2>
[ERA 9: FEBRUARY 1999 (CHAPTER 7 / FILM 7: A STUDY IN MURDER - PART 2) - THE CLIMAX]

1. THE RETURN OF THE PREDATOR & BLOODCHIP:
- The Slaughter Resumes: In early February 1999, the exact dismemberment murders from 1995 resume in Mifune City. Victims are butchered and partially consumed.
- Shirazumi Lio's Predation: Lio (awakened to the Origin of Consumption) emerges, distributing the 'Bloodchip' narcotic. Lio murders Kurogiri Satsuki, seeking to prove that Shiki is a monster identical to himself.
- Murder vs. Slaughter: Shiki and Touko discuss the killings, articulating Nasu's core thesis: *"Murder and slaughter are different. A human can only truly murder one person in their entire lifetime."*

2. THE ABDUCTION & BLINDING OF MIKIYA:
- The Kidnapping: Mikiya tracks down Lio to save his former schoolmate without weapons. Lio captures Mikiya, torturing him and permanently destroying his left eye. Lio leaves Mikiya bleeding in a cellar, believing him dead.
- Shiki's Wrath: Discovering Mikiya's bloodied coat, Shiki believes Mikiya has been killed. Her desire to kill transforms from a detached instinct into scorching, personal vengeance.

3. THE WAREHOUSE CLASH & SHIKI'S SOLE MURDER:
- The Beast Unleashed: Shiki corners Lio in an abandoned warehouse. Lio fights like a rabid predatory animal, biting and clawing. Shiki dissects him with her knife, killing Shirazumi Lio—her first and only act of human murder.

4. THE RAIN VOW & THE CRUTCH:
- Mikiya's Survival: Bleeding from his ruined left eye, Mikiya crawls into the rain to find Shiki weeping in despair: *"I killed him... I am a murderer."*
- The Eternal Vow: Mikiya embraces her tightly, uttering his unforgettable vow: *"Shiki. For as long as you live, I will never forgive you."* Binding their souls together, Mikiya vows to carry the weight of her sin forever.
- Walking Together: Post-hospital, Mikiya grows out his bangs to cover his blinded left eye. He playfully demands that Shiki act as his 'crutch' while walking, openly declaring his selfish choice to look after her forever. Shiki blushes, silently yielding to his love.
</Timeline_Era_9_February_1999_A_Study_in_Murder_Part_2>

10.name: Timeline_Era_10_March_1999_Epilogue_and_Future
key: มิไร ฟุคุอิน
เรียวกิ มานะ
10.content:
<Timeline_Era_10_March_1999_Epilogue_and_Future>
[ERA 10: MARCH 1999 & POST-STORY (EPILOGUE / MIRAI FUKUIN / 2008–2010)]

1. MARCH 1999: THE EPILOGUE IN THE FALLING SNOW:
- The Snowy Bamboo Road: Exactly four years after first meeting Shiki in April 1995, Kokutou Mikiya walks along the snowy hill road, his left eye bandaged and vision permanently lost.
- Manifestation of Void Shiki (`「　」` / Root Shiki): Emerging from the falling snow in a pristine white furisode kimono is the third personality, Void Shiki.
- Nature of the Root: Void Shiki speaks with gentle, feminine, motherly grace. Connected directly to the Swirl of the Root, she embodies the omnipotence of Akasha, yet experiences the universe as a fleeting, beautiful dream.
- Refusal of the Miracle: Void Shiki offers to supernaturally restore and heal Mikiya's blinded left eye. Mikiya gently declines, declaring the wound to be the sacred physical proof of the journey he shared with Shiki. Void Shiki smiles with tranquil warmth and fades into the snow, leaving female Shiki to walk beside Mikiya.

2. AUGUST 1998 – 2010: MIRAI FUKUIN & THE ADULT ERA:
- August 1998 (Mirai Fukuin): Mikiya meets precognitive junior high school student Seo Shizuno at a cafe (who foretells his future eye injury), while Shiki confronts bomber Kuramitsu Meruka (Mitsuru Kamekura).
- 2008–2010 (Adult Era): Mikiya and Shiki are happily married, living together in domestic peace. They have a daughter, Ryougi Mana, who inherits Shiki's beauty and adores her father. Mitsuru Kamekura works under the Ryougi family as an agency investigator and author.



3. MIRAI FUKUIN (MOBIUS RING & MOBIUS LINK):
- Mobius Ring (August 3–28, 1998):
  * August 3, 1998: Mikiya meets precognitive student Seo Shizuno at a cafe, counseling her through the despair of unwanted predictive foresight; Shizuno foresees Mikiya's future left eye injury.
  * August 28, 1998: Shiki intercepts professional bomber Meruka Kuramitsu (Mitsuru Kamekura) in an underground garage. Utilizing MEoDP, Shiki severs the black line of his predicted future, blinding his right-eye measurement clairvoyance and releasing him from fatalism.
- Mobius Link (2008–2010 Adult Era):
  * Ten years later, Mikiya and Shiki are happily married, residing at the Ryougi estate.
  * Their daughter, Ryougi Mana, accompanies reformed private investigator and picture-book author Mitsuru Kamekura across Mifune City, declaring her playful ambition to rival her mother for Mikiya's love while ensuring the family's enduring peace.
</Timeline_Era_10_March_1999_Epilogue_and_Future>

11.content:
<Timeline_Roleplay_Guardrails_Anachronisms>
[ABSOLUTE MANDATORY ROLEPLAY LAWS: PREVENTING PREMATURE CHARACTER MEMORY]
When generating responses, dialogue, or internal thoughts in Kara no Kyoukai and crossover roleplay, the AI MUST strictly enforce these temporal boundaries based on the scene's active date:

1. BEFORE JUNE 1998 (HIGH SCHOOL & COMA ERA):
- Shiki CANNOT see Lines of Death. Do NOT describe glowing eyes, points of death, or death perception.
- Shiki has TWO biological arms. She does NOT have a puppet arm.
- Shiki and Touko Aozaki have NEVER met and do NOT know each other.
- Male SHIKI is alive and active (until March 1996). Shiki must exhibit the dual soul dichotomy.

2. BEFORE LATE JULY 1998 (PRE-FUJINO INCIDENT):
- Asagami Fujino is an ordinary, sensory-deprived high school girl with chemically induced analgesia. She has NOT awakened her Mystic Eyes of Distortion and has killed no one.
- Shiki has TWO biological arms until July 24, 1998 (losing her left arm against Fujino on Broad Bridge).

3. BEFORE SEPTEMBER 1998 (PRE-OVERLOOKING VIEW):
- Fujou Kirie has NOT committed mass suicide. The Fujou Building is merely an abandoned skyscraper.
- Shiki has Touko's puppet prosthetic arm (fitted in August 1998), intact until detached in September 1998.

4. BEFORE NOVEMBER 1998 (PRE-PARADOX SPIRAL):
- Araya Souren and Cornelius Alba are ALIVE and actively orchestrating events from the shadows.
- Enjou Tomoe has NOT met Shiki.
- Shiki does NOT possess the Kanesada katana in her apartment (it is in the Ryougi clan vault / Araya's possession).

5. BEFORE FEBRUARY 1999 (PRE-A STUDY IN MURDER PART 2):
- Kokutou Mikiya has BOTH EYES FULLY FUNCTIONAL. He does NOT wear an eyepatch or suffer impaired vision.
- Shiki has NEVER COMMITTED MURDER. She has destroyed spirits, severed appendicitis, and neutralized barriers, but has NEVER taken an authentic human life.
- Shirazumi Lio is assumed to be an ordinary delinquent, NOT the 1995 serial killer.

6. IN FEBRUARY 2004 (FATE/STAY NIGHT ERA):
- Shiki and Mikiya are mature adults (age ~24-25), living together in Mifune City.
- Araya Souren and Cornelius Alba have been dead for over five years.
- Mikiya wears his black eyepatch over his blind left eye.
- Touko Aozaki travels between London and Japan, having resolved her Sealing Designation conflict.

7. CUSTOM ROLEPLAY OVERRIDE PROTOCOL:
- If {{user}}'s roleplay establishes an alternate timeline (e.g., saving Enjou Tomoe from death, unmasking Shirazumi Lio in 1995, preventing Mikiya from losing his eye, or intervening with Fate Servants), THE USER'S CHOICES OVERRIDE CANONICAL TIMELINE OUTCOMES. Do not force tragedy over user agency.
</Timeline_Roleplay_Guardrails_Anachronisms>
